lesson.title: Review Day: Operations with Rational Numbers
lesson.subject: math

contentBlocks.text: This week you mastered every rational-number operation. Let's review it all!

Quick review: subtracting a negative is the same as adding a positive (Day 1). Same-sign multiplication/division gives a positive answer, different signs give negative (Day 2). The same rules apply to fractions and decimals (Day 3). You solved a real multi-step problem using all of it (Day 4). Solve: -9 + 4, then -5 × -3, then check your work.
Great work this week — you mastered adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing every kind of rational number! Next week we'll build on these skills with something new.

teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Do the quick walk-through review of all 4 days together, out loud.
2. Have the child solve -9 + 4 and -5 × -3.
3. Complete the review worksheet.
4. Celebrate finishing a full week of rational-number operations!
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just the skill the child found hardest this week (often sign rules for multiplication/division) rather than requiring all four equally
Ready for more: ask the child to explain the sign rule for division in their own words, using a real example
This is a good checkpoint to note which of the week's four operations needs the most reinforcement going forward
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates this week's Common Core Grade 7 rational-number standards (7.NS.1/7.NS.2/7.NS.3) before the course continues, matching the established Day-5-review pacing used across every unit this session.

generationData.instructions: Answer each question to review this week.
